limitations: Single P60 mature-neuron snapshot: graph geometry is exploratory state structure, not observed lineage or elapsed time.
Reference distances have arbitrary genotype-blind geometric origins; not developmental pseudotime.
graph_test is graph autocorrelation on the same data, not independent-mouse genotype differential expression.
Sequencing partition partly overlaps genotype; same-partition display is a filter of the same graph, not a refit.
Prepared features sum duplicate symbols; original gene IDs are preserved without fabricated disaggregation.
Native size factors use retained eligible features; full original library UMIs are separately exported.
